aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable condition/result rows but the changed-factor grouping and baseline use are not reliable enough for final Ask AI evidence.
issues: Changed factor improperly bundles many unrelated line checks into one comparison string.
Baseline row is reused inside changedCondition, creating self-comparison ambiguity.
Rows 13,20,21 are cited in factor evidence but not represented in outcomes.
Outcome metric should be NG rate/input/NG, not the section header.
Several cited comparison rows are not shown in context, limiting row-level verification.
requiredUserQuestions: Is old material intended as the baseline for all condition checks?
Should cleaning-agent rows be separate comparisons or part of the same condition screen?
correctionPlan: Define the changed factor as a condition-screen for MG+YK separation, or split by material lot, oven condition, bond amount, and cleaning method.
Remove the baseline condition from changedCondition.
Create one subresult per result-table item with input, NG, NG rate, note, and exact row citation.
Include all cited result rows, especially rows 14,15,18,19, with row text available for verification.
Set judgement per subresult from NG rate versus the confirmed baseline and keep overall judgement nuanced.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficiently organized and partly unavailable for final evidence.
